decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 5 - Except at the point of vehicle access the existing front boundary wall shall be re-erected and permanently retained, before the access is first brought into use.
Condition : 6 - The proposed crossover shall not exceed 3.00m wide.

Condition : 7 - A replacement tree shall be planted within the curtilage of the property within one year of the removal of the tree on the front boundary. This shall be planted within the planting season following the removal of the tree, i.e. between October and March.
description: Formation of a vehicular access to the front of the property
